svg.aria-label: Five model families drawn as layer stacks: dense attention, mixture of experts, multi-head latent attention, hybrid Mamba-attention, and sliding-window attention, with the relative KV cache per token and the serving implications of each.
svg.title: Five model families drawn as layer stacks: dense attention, mixture of experts, multi-head latent attention, hybrid Mamba-attention, and sliding-window attention, with the relative KV cache per token and the serving implications of each.
svg.text: Model architecture decides the serving design
What grows with context, what disaggregation must move, and which parallelism fits.
Bars are illustrative relative sizes, not measurements. KV per token = 2 × layers × KV heads × head dim × bytes for attention layers.
